note: Research evidence is supporting material only. /docs/ remains authoritative for active project requirements. Dynamic evidence such as SERPs, contractor offerings, hiring, pricing, and Google policies must be reverified before relying on it for a future material decision.

rules: Paraphrase. Do not copy long copyrighted passages; short excerpts only where exact policy language matters.
source_date is the document's own date (or its 'last updated' date) in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null when no day-level date is shown.
Never upgrade a status without new evidence. INFERENCE stays labeled as inference in evidence_summary or limitations.

files.stale_after: Re-verify before indexing any Lawrence page, and at least every 6 months. Re-check sooner if the City updates its code (American Legal supplements) or Construction Specifications page.
Re-verify before any outreach, and at least every 3 months (offerings, hiring, and financing change often).
Re-verify after any announced Google core or spam update, and at least every 6 months.
A point-in-time snapshot. Do not edit it; add a new dated snapshot file instead. Re-capture before any material publishing decision.
